name: Tree
description: A family of typographic trees. From sapling to ancient hollow, through winter bare and fire-charred. Every tree is a door if you know where to look.

sapling.description: First growth. Thin bark. Few branches. The forest's promise.

interaction.label: Observe the sapling
whispers: Barely a season old. The bark is still smooth. You could snap it with your hands.
It leans toward the light. Patient. It has no concept of time.
A single leaf trembles. There is no wind.

mature.description: Full canopy. Deep roots. Bears witness to the forest.

interaction.label: Rest beneath the tree
whispers: The shade is cool. Something scurries in the branches above. You are not alone.
Roots surface here and there. One of them looks almost like a hand. Almost.
A bird calls. Another answers. The forest is talking. You are the subject.

ancient.description: Centuries deep. The forest's memory. Birds nest in its crown, fungi at its feet.

interaction.label: Touch the ancient bark
whispers: The bark is warm. Your hand fits into a groove worn by a thousand other hands.
You feel it breathing. Slow. In. Out. One breath per season.
Something is carved here. Old letters. You almost recognize them.
The tree remembers fire. It remembers flood. It remembers when this was all ice.

hollow.description: The ancient has opened. A doorway in the trunk. Something lives inside now.

openings.description: A hollow in the trunk. Large enough to enter. The darkness inside breathes.

interior.description: The hollow's interior. Dark. Warm. The walls are lined with old fur and older bones.

interaction.label: Enter the hollow
whispers: You duck inside. It's larger than it looked. Something shifts in the dark.
The walls are smooth. Worn by bodies. You are not the first to shelter here.
A whisper, very close: 'Leave an offering. Or don't. The tree takes either way.'
You find a small bone. A bird skull. It fits in your palm. You may keep it or return it.

fallen.description: The great tree lies down. A bridge. A bench. A slow return to soil.

interaction.label: Sit on the fallen trunk
whispers: The wood is soft with rot. Your weight settles into it. The ground will take it back soon.
Mushrooms line the underside. Tiny white cities. You disturb nothing.
You sit. The forest sits with you. A long silence. Then a bird, unconcerned, resumes.

winterBare.description: Ice in the branches. No leaves. The tree as skeleton.

interaction.label: Brush the frost away
whispers: Ice crystals cling to your fingers. They don't melt. They're not cold. They're something else.
Beneath the frost, the bark is black. The tree is not dead. It's waiting.
The branches rattle. There is no wind. It's the tree, shivering.

charred.description: Fire passed through. The tree stands black. But it stands.

glyphCarving.text: B U R N E D   B U T   N O T   G O N E

interaction.label: Touch the charred bark
whispers: Still warm. The fire was recent. Or the tree has never stopped burning inside.
Your fingers come away black. The soot is fine. It smells like incense.
The trunk is hollow now. The fire carved a doorway where there was none before.

blooming.description: Spring comes. The tree erupts in flower. Sacred. Overwhelming.

interaction.label: Stand beneath the blossoms
whispers: Petals fall on your shoulders. They smell like honey and something older.
A bee the size of your thumb drifts past. It's not interested in you. It's on pilgrimage.
The tree is celebrating something. A wedding? A birth? A century of survival? All of them.
One blossom lands in your palm. It's warm. It pulses, once. Then it's just a flower.
